elements.quote: Despite their importance and wide application, the quality of meta-analyses is highly variable [1,7,10,11]. If the quality of meta-analyses is poor, it is hard to know if 'biological meta-analysis embodies 'mega-enlightenment', a 'mega-mistake', or something in between' [12].
elements.reason: Describes the current state of knowledge (wide application of meta-analyses) and important uncertainties (variability in quality).

elements.quote: Assessing the current compliance with recommended steps for reporting and execution in ecological meta-analyses and identifying places that need improvements can help guide the meta-analytic community towards more robust inference and reduce controversy.
elements.reason: Explains the importance and need for conducting the review to assess compliance and improve meta-analytic practices.

elements.quote: In this paper, we reviewed the literature assessing the quality of ecological meta-analyses, collected new data to evaluate current practices, and highlight the areas that need more work. First, we compiled information from 18 studies in the last 20 years (between 2002 and 2022) that reviewed the quality of meta-analyses in ecology, evolution and related fields.
elements.reason: Identifies and cites previous similar systematic reviews, explaining the need for the current review to compile and synthesize data from multiple reviews.
The review is a meta-evaluation of the quality of reporting and execution in ecological meta-analyses, not a review of intervention effects, so this element does not apply.
The review does not involve complex interventions or delivery contexts; it assesses meta-analytic practices, so this element does not apply.
